product.name: Complaint Desk
jobs: Find complaints by title prefix and priority
Inspect the selected complaint and record timestamps
Edit typed fields, review changes and save with a reason
Cancel safely without losing saved data
accessibility: Keyboard reachable named actions and restored focus
Status text remains available without color
Readable text in light and dark themes
constraints: Dataverse bindings and typed choice values are immutable during design refinement
Preserve required reason and review before SubmitForm
Default environment is non-disposable; only the owned experiment app may be changed
No intentional business data creation, update or deletion during visual validation
Record timestamps are not a complete audit history
Large-data aggregation and separate-user permissions remain separate validation gates

desktop.backBehavior: return to previous context without changing data
desktop.reason: Available space supports preserving the current job and information hierarchy through responsive adaptation.

tablet.detailPresentation: focused record below 960; adjacent detail at 960 and above
tablet.listDetailRelationship: exclusive below 960; simultaneous on wider tablets
tablet.backBehavior: return to previous context without changing data
tablet.reason: Portrait tablet uses a focused record to avoid travel below a long queue; wider tablet keeps the queue alongside detail without duplicating state.

mobile.actionPlacement: fixed footer outside the scroll body with bottom inset
mobile.detailPresentation: dedicated full-height surface; task form replaces the surface
mobile.commandVisibility: only current-task commands; background disabled during edit
mobile.listDetailRelationship: mutually exclusive surfaces with stable selected identity
mobile.backBehavior: record returns to list; editor cancel checks unsaved changes before return
mobile.formBehavior: single column; scroll fields independently; persistent review/save; explicit discard
mobile.reason: Simultaneous queue and record context creates excessive travel; completing one task at a time preserves identity and reachable actions.

visualCharacter: Record identity before commands; urgency before totals

density.notes: daily operations work on desktop: Record identity before commands; urgency before totals

spacing.philosophy: Tight within records; clear section rhythm

principles: Record identity before commands; urgency before totals
Below 640: touch targets at least 44, stacked reading order, fixed task dock
640–959: focused record with Back; 960–1099: compact split

dos: Keep task actions visible and context intact
Preserve typed data and review before save
donts: Do not create equal-weight unrelated KPI cards
Do not wrap every section in a card
Do not rely on color alone

supported: Modern text, buttons, containers, semantic Power Fx tokens
translated: Quiet status becomes modern text with explicit priority
Hover disclosure becomes explicit touchable action
